passage.label: Inquire of them does your Lord have daughters while they have sons, or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses; out of their invented falsehood they say Allah has begotten and they are liars; has He chosen daughters over sons; what is wrong with you, how do you make judgement; will you not be reminded, or do you have a clear authority, then produce your scripture if you are truthful; they claimed a lineage between Him and the jinn but the jinn already know they will be brought to punishment; exalted is Allah above what they describe, except the chosen servants; you and whatever you worship cannot tempt anyone away from Him except he who is to burn in the Hellfire; there is not among us any except that he has a known position, we are those who line up and we are those who exalt Allah; the disbelievers used to say if we had a message from the former peoples we would have been the chosen servants, but they disbelieved in it so they are going to know; Our word has already preceded for Our servants the messengers that they would be given victory and that Our soldiers will be those who overcome; leave them for a time and see, for they are going to see; for Our punishment are they impatient, but when it descends in their territory evil is the morning of those warned; leave them for a time and see, for they are going to see; exalted is your Lord the Lord of might above what they describe; peace upon the messengers; praise to Allah Lord of the worlds

arabicExcerpts.text: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثٗا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبٗاۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

mainSubject.label: The daughter-attribution interrogated against their own preference for sons and the absent witness to angelic creation; begetting declared invented falsehood and the choice-of-daughters claim challenged as defective judgement; the demand for clear authority and a produced scripture; the asserted jinn-lineage refuted by the jinn's own knowledge of presentation for punishment; divine transcendence with the chosen-servant exemption; the limits of temptation excluding only the destined burner; the angelic declaration of known station, ranked alignment and glorification; the disbelievers' conditional claim of sincerity invalidated by their actual disbelief; the prior word guaranteeing messenger victory and the overcoming of divine soldiers; repeated leave-and-see patience commands against punishment-impatience and the evil morning of territorial descent; closing tasbih of the Lord of might, salam upon the messengers and hamd to the Lord of the worlds

subordinateSubjects.label: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons
Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses
Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say
Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars
Has He chosen daughters over sons
What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement
Then will you not be reminded
Or do you have a clear authority
Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful
And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such cl...
Exalted is Allah above what they describe
Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin]
So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship
You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire
[The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position
And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]
And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah
And indeed, the disbelievers used to say
If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples
We would have been the chosen servants of Allah
But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know
And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers
[That] indeed, they would be those given victory
And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome
So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time
And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see
Then for Our punishment are they impatient
But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned
And leave them for a time
And see, for they are going to see
Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe
And peace upon the messengers
And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds

commandsAndProhibitions.description: So inquire of them whether their Lord has daughters while they have sons — interrogative refutation.
Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful — evidentiary demand.
So leave them for a time — prophetic withdrawal command.
And see, for they are going to see — mutual observation command.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Begetting attributed to Allah declared invented falsehood, with the choice of daughters over sons challenged as defective judgement
Angelic self-declaration: each has a known position, they line up and they exalt Allah
Conditional claim of sincerity had a former message reached them, invalidated by their actual disbelief

relationships.label: Prior word for the messenger servants guaranteeing their victory and the overcoming of divine soldiers
Claimed lineage between Allah and the jinn refuted by the jinn's knowledge that the claimants will be brought to punishment
Closing sequence: tasbih of the Lord of might above their descriptions, salam upon the messengers, hamd to the Lord of the worlds
